verdict.rationale: The public docs, served as agent-readable markdown and indexed via llms.txt, cover each step. Auth uses API credentials or short-lived JWTs. Fast mode returns a finished transcript synchronously in one call, so creation and retrieval need no human step. Batch mode writes transcripts back next to their S3 inputs. missing for 10: explicit transcription endpoint paths and request examples in the evidence, a documented batch job status/polling flow, detail on minting JWTs from the key, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent run.
